name: Long Island

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Merlot, Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A New York AVA covering Nassau and Suffolk counties, including offshore islands, with the North Fork and the Hamptons inside. In Suffolk County, Merlot leads plantings at 32%, then Chardonnay at 22% and Cabernet Franc at 11%.
